findings.description: Latin two-column text remains readable. Note sets on pages 1–5 have separate indented starts and ends; final page retains source exhortation, blessing, date and LEO PP. XIII subscription before ruled apparatus which continues in right column. Some literal internal hard-line hyphens and isolated native letterspaced words remain, without sustained unreadability.

documents.limitations: Independent full-page reader layout and bounded native source-boundary/repair acceptance. Every actual reader page inspected in contact overview and individually at original raster resolution. Native evidence is OCR reconstruction geometry, not original-print glyph or lexical collation; no translation accuracy, rights certification, exhaustive discovery or whole-volume completeness claim. No page reuse.
